run_make_changelog: run the make_changelog script to extract changelog entries from closed GitHub issues labeled needs changelog
extract_changelog_entries: extract suggested changelog entries from GitHub issue bodies using the ENTRY regex pattern matching rst code blocks
list_missing_changelog_issues: list closed GitHub issues that are missing a suggested changelog entry and display their titles and URLs
format_changelog_with_rich: format extracted changelog entries with rich syntax highlighting using RST theme and word wrapping
query_github_issues: query the pybind pybind11 GitHub repository for closed issues with the needs changelog label using ghapi
